arguments.task: In the NCATS PubChem compound database for Food Additive Status classification, find the compound that has a molecular weight of 100 g/mol or less, 6 heavy atoms, 1 or fewer hydrogen bond acceptors, and a complexity between 10 and 15. Of the shared gene-chemical co-occurrences between its two possible enzyme transformations, what is the PubChem CID of the heaviest by molecular weight?

arguments.task_description: Please help locate the detailed dataset or record from the NCATS PubChem compound database for Food Additive Status classification. We are looking for a compound that satisfies these criteria: a molecular weight of 100 g/mol or less, exactly 6 heavy atoms, 1 or fewer hydrogen bond acceptors, and a complexity between 10 and 15. This specific compound has exactly two enzyme transformation records. For these two enzyme transformations, there is gene–chemical co-occurrence data, some of which are shared between both transformations. We need to identify, among that shared set of co-occurring compounds, the one with the highest (heaviest) molecular weight, and then report its PubChem CID. Please provide all the relevant details (including how the compound was identified, the enzyme transformation details, the shared co-occurrence compounds along with their molecular weights) so that we can verify the answer.
